phase: Phases 0-6 (Schema, Store, Refactor, Cleanup, Login wiring, Captcha, Exports/README)
summary: Phases 0-6 of the Postgres-Backed Rate Limiter v2 track are complete and meet all spec/test-strategy acceptance criteria. FR-1 through FR-7 are verified against implementation, tests, and commits. All scoped gates (unit tests, client-ip tests, schema parity, typecheck, build, lint, grep gate) are green. No `any` types in new production code. All three review passes (a/b/c) are PASS or pass_with_fixes with blocking findings resolved; deferred items (SEC-4 reset-password.ts XFF alignment, IR-1/INFRA-2 integration tests) are out of scope with named owners. Anti-patterns A1, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 all verified clear.

FR-1_login_attempts_table.evidence: packages/db/src/schema/auth.ts:11-25 declares loginAttempts with columns id, identifier, kind, failedCount, windowStart, lastAttemptAt + uniqueIndex login_attempts_identifier_kind_idx + index login_attempts_window_start_idx. Barrel re-export via packages/db/src/schema/index.ts:2 (export * from ./auth.js).

FR-2_drizzle_migration.evidence: packages/db/drizzle/0024_futuristic_vulture.sql creates login_attempts table with both indexes (unique identifier+kind btree, window_start btree).

FR-3_rate_limit_store.evidence: packages/auth/src/rate-limit-store.ts createPostgresRateLimitStore implements get/set/delete/increment using SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (.for('update')) + onConflictDoUpdate. Note CR-1: shipped API is createPostgresRateLimitStore(db, config) returning a RateLimitStore; the checkRateLimit/recordFailure/resetLimit functions are exported from rate-limit.ts (documented contract divergence from spec's proposed signatures).

FR-4_rate_limit_refactor.evidence: packages/auth/src/rate-limit.ts: configurePostgresRateLimiter is the production default (line 219-237). In-memory Map dual-gated behind isInMemoryFastPathEnabled() requiring NODE_ENV==='development' AND RATE_LIMIT_INMEMORY_FASTPATH==='true' (line 155-160). checkRateLimitByIp exported (line 384-392, added by review-c fix). Grep gate: exactly 1 'new Map' hit at line 115 (the dev inMemoryStore).

FR-5_cleanup_job.evidence: packages/auth/src/rate-limit-cleanup.ts: cleanupOldAttempts deletes rows with window_start < now()-24h in LIMIT 1000 batches (CLEANUP_BATCH_SIZE=1000), loop terminates on empty batch. RATE_LIMIT_CLEANUP_LOCK_KEY (0x7261_7465_6c69_6d63n) distinct from AUDIT_RETENTION_LOCK_KEY (verified by test). createRateLimitCleanupJob factory with idempotent start/stop, defaults intervalMs=1h.

FR-6_login_wiring.evidence: packages/api/src/routes/auth/login.ts: getClientIp (TRUST_PROXY_COUNT-aware, packages/api/src/routes/auth/client-ip.ts) extracts IP; checkRateLimit(lowerUsername, clientIp) checks both buckets; 429 response includes Retry-After header (line 82) + captchaRequired (line 78); recordFailure uses atomic store.increment; resetLimit on success (line 200). captchaRequired surfaced in all 401/429 response paths.

FR-7_captcha_trigger.evidence: packages/auth/src/rate-limit.ts: CAPTCHA_THRESHOLD=3 (line 86); checkIdentifier sets captchaRequired = entry.failedCount >= CAPTCHA_THRESHOLD (line 268). Captcha test verifies at-threshold (toBe true), below-threshold (not.toBe true), and IP-independence refutations.
